content.headline: Corporate support & sponsorship
content.subheadline: Partner with BNMS to support education, professional development and the future of nuclear medicine.

content.html:
The British Nuclear Medicine Society works closely with industry partners and organisations that share our commitment to advancing nuclear medicine and improving patient care.

Through sponsorship, educational support and conference partnerships, organisations can help support the professional development of the nuclear medicine community while increasing their visibility within the specialty.
Partnering to advance Nuclear Medicine
• Support excellence, innovation and professional achievement through a BNMS award or fellowship.
• Support one of the Society's scientific meetings, educational events or conferences.

BNMS offers opportunities for organisations to support:

  • Scientific meetings and conferences.

  • Educational programmes.

  • Awards and fellowships.

  • Professional development activities.

  • Special projects and initiatives.

  • Student and trainee support.
• Demonstrate your commitment to education, research and professional development.
• Connect with the multidisciplinary nuclear medicine community across the UK.

BNMS values long-term relationships with organisations that support the advancement of nuclear medicine.

Partnership opportunities can be tailored to meet both organisational objectives and the Society's charitable aims.

If you are interested in discussing sponsorship opportunities, award funding or educational partnerships, we would be pleased to hear from you.

T: 0115 671 5705

E: charlotte@bnms.org.uk
